hints.title: Tree Path Propagation
hints.text: Ancestors of any node form a simple path connecting the root to the node's parent.

hints.title: Square Predicate
hints.text: Check if an ancestor's value is an integer perfect square before adding it to the running branch sum.

hints.title: Top-Down Traversal
hints.text: Carry the accumulated sum down during a tree search traversal, recording it at each child.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Linear depth-first traversal with constant square checks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing upwards to root per node incurs O(N^2) worst case on degenerate trees.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) recursion stack and adjacency list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Top-down prefix accumulation on tree structure in single traversal.
